metadata.title: Tesla’s stock falls as Cybercab launch lands with a thud - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Tesla’s stock falls as Cybercab launch lands with a thud
The company’s Cybercab rollout won’t be as broad as some investors had hoped
Tesla shares are trading lower on Friday, as a much-hyped robotaxi event appears to have fallen flat.
The electric-vehicle maker on Thursday held a launch event for the Cybercab, a two-seat, purpose-built autonomous vehicle that doesn’t have a steering wheel or pedals. The vehicle is expected to be cheaper to operate than other Tesla TSLA vehicles and to showcase the company’s technological progress.
